header: ONE NUMBER FOR EVERY SOURCE OF A DEEP SUMMARY (EDS). The engine, its citations, its second reader and its stored briefings all know a source by a number. Circulars and announcements are in different tables, each with its own row numbers, so the same number can mean a circular and an announcement. I therefore move an ANNOUNCEMENT's number above every circular's: base + its own id. Circulars keep their own numbers (nothing stored under them changes). Whoever shows a source (a chip, a card) asks here which kind it is and what its real id is.

symbols.name: ANNOUNCEMENT_SOURCE_BASE
doc: Added to an announcement's id wherever it travels as an EDS source. Circular ids are far below it (hundreds), and an announcement id must be below it too.

symbols.name: announcementSourceId
symbols.sig: export function announcementSourceId(id: number): number | null
doc: Returns the EDS source number of an announcement, or null if its id cannot be moved (not a whole number from 1 to base - 1).

symbols.name: realSourceId
doc: Returns the announcement's real id from its EDS source number. A number that is not one comes back as it is, because it is a circular's.
